Hey - I've left some high level feedback:

- The change from `Unknown toolId: ${(_exhaustive as MeechieToolInput).toolId}` to `Unknown toolId: ${JSON.stringify(_exhaustive)}` improves context but introduces a potential `JSON.stringify` failure for circular/BigInt values; consider a safer serialization helper (or including both `toolId` and a guarded JSON dump) to avoid masking the original error.
- For `readJson` and `parseJsonCandidate`, changing the return type from `unknown | null` to `unknown` still allows `null` at runtime but hides this in the type; consider either keeping `null` in the union or tightening the implementation to actually eliminate `null` if you want the narrower type.

## Pull request overview This PR applies a small refactor across adapters and the Meechie studio text pipeline to reduce duplication, improve the debuggability of an exhaustiveness guard, and simplify redundant TypeScript union types. **Changes:** - Deduplicates `pageSizeLine` by importing the canonical helper from `$lib/core/prompt-template`. - Improves the default-case exhaustiveness error in `meechie-tool.adapter.ts` by stringifying the unexpected input. - Removes redundant `| null` from `unknown` return annotations (since `unknown` already includes `null`) in two local JSON parsing helpers. ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 4 out of 4 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | src/lib/adapters/image-generation.adapter.ts | Replaces local `pageSizeLine` with import from shared prompt-template helpers. | | src/lib/adapters/meechie-tool.adapter.ts | Adjusts exhaustiveness-check throw message to include full unexpected payload via `JSON.stringify`. | | src/lib/adapters/provider-adapter.adapter.ts | Simplifies local `readJson` return type to `Promise` (still returns `null` at runtime when appropriate). | | src/lib/core/meechie-studio-text-pipeline.ts | Simplifies local `parseJsonCandidate` return type to `unknown` (still returns `null` on parse failure). | --- 💡 Add Copilot custom instructions for smarter, more guided reviews. Learn how to get started.

## Code Review

This pull request refactors several adapters and utility functions. It externalizes the `pageSizeLine` helper to a shared prompt-template module, simplifies the return types of JSON parsing utilities from `unknown | null` to `unknown`, and updates the exhaustive error handling in `meechie-tool.adapter.ts`. Feedback on the changes points out a potential information disclosure vulnerability in `meechie-tool.adapter.ts`, where serializing the entire `input` object using `JSON.stringify` could leak sensitive user data into application logs. A suggestion is provided to extract only the invalid `toolId` instead.
